context_for_next_testing_agent: Progressive pattern system for Bar Mode is fully implemented and tested. The check_patterns_progressive() function in server.py correctly tracks all three patterns. The daub_number endpoint uses this for Bar Mode games. Frontend shows pattern tracker with 4 CORNERS, LINE, FULL HOUSE indicators. Admin password is 5749.

rca_of_the_issue.original_bug: Game was ending prematurely when any pattern (like Four Corners or Line) was matched, instead of continuing until Full House
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The original check_win() function was used for all game modes, which returns True on any pattern match
rca_of_the_issue.fix_implemented: New check_patterns_progressive() function added that returns status of all three patterns separately. The daub_number endpoint now uses this for Bar Mode and only sets winner=True when full_house is True
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Backend tests confirm: Four Corners → winner=False, Line → winner=False, Full House → winner=True
